lines.text: Many learners say: If it will rain, I will stay home.
Better: If it rains, I will stay home.
After if, say rains, not will rain.
Comes! If he comes late, call me.

data.wrong: If it will rain, I will stay home.
data.right: If it rains, I will stay home.
data.why: After if, say rains, not will rain.
data.memory: If it rains, I stay home.

native.tip: हिंदी में “अगर बारिश होगी” भविष्य में कहते हैं, पर अंग्रेज़ी में if के बाद will नहीं लगता; “If it rains” कहें।
native.caption: क्या आप भी यही कहते हैं? “If it will rain, I will stay home.” 😅 सही रूप है “If it rains, I will stay home.” क्योंकि if के बाद will नहीं लगता। Ama की आवाज़ सुनकर दोहराइए! Lexkite ऐप में और अभ्यास करें।

en.tip: Hindi speakers often put will after if, but English uses rains there.
en.caption: Do you say this? “If it will rain, I will stay home.” 😅 The right way is “If it rains, I will stay home.” This is right because if takes no will. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
